articles.summary: Kairos is an open-source platform for real-time fraud and risk decisions. Your coding agent designs the experiments, Kairos runs them on your data, and Grayson's answers sit next to your own fields in the models it tests.
articles.title: Introducing Kairos: open-source fraud decisioning, tuned by your coding agent

articles.summary: Rules are easy for fraudsters to probe, XGBoost models lag new fraud by months, and LLMs cost too much to run on every event. Why decision models like Grayson bring an analyst's judgment to every fraud decision, and where they beat what fraud teams already run.
articles.title: Why decision models are the next step in fraud prevention
